issues.issue: assumption: the Road Fund's Intergovernmental line is treated as highway allocation, but the report does not break it down

p2 prints Road Project Cost Reimbursements 986,308 inside the statement's Miscellaneous. Road Fund Miscellaneous is the only fund line big enough to hold it, so this line is very likely more than 99% reimbursements (reimbursements/refunds). The page does not print a by-fund split, so other is defensible.

p2 prints Insurance Reimbursements 513,606. Once the road reimbursements are placed in the Road Fund, only the Insurance Fund's Miscellaneous can hold it, so this line is likely about 71% reimbursements (reimbursements/refunds). There is no by-fund split on the page.
